subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Should this PR require current-head live proof from official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override that gate based on the focused stream tests and provider-scoping evidence?
rationale: The patch has no supported line-level correctness finding, but the external contribution changes message-stream delivery and its available live evidence exercises only the deliberately unaffected Ollama routes.

options.title: Require official-provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR human-gated until a redacted live transcript, logs, or terminal output shows the current head removing the marker through official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal without damaging ordinary output.

options.title: Explicitly override proof
options.body: Accept the focused tests and ownership evidence as sufficient while consciously owning the residual official-transport and message-sequencing risk.

recommendation.title: Require official-provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR human-gated until a redacted live transcript, logs, or terminal output shows the current head removing the marker through official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal without damaging ordinary output.

likelyOwner.reason: They identified the correct provider boundary, requested this rewrite, and explicitly paused automerge pending the revised review.
